goal_operations.pick: the final goal only grasps or lifts an object while keeping it held, with no destination specified
goal_operations.remove: the final goal detaches or takes an object out, off, or away from a source, without a later destination
goal_operations.place: the final goal moves a discrete object to a destination, container, surface, or spatial position; includes put, set, stack, and deposit; the moved item remains intact
goal_operations.move: the final goal changes an object's position or arrangement but the instruction does not specify whether it is grasped or pushed
goal_operations.push: the final goal translates or slides a non-button object by sustained pushing contact
goal_operations.open: the final goal makes a door, drawer, lid, faucet, or articulated mechanism open or on, even when achieved by operating a control
goal_operations.close: the final goal makes a door, drawer, lid, faucet, or articulated mechanism closed or off
goal_operations.insert: the final goal tightly fits or plugs an object into a slot, socket, hole, or fixture; not loose placement in a container
goal_operations.rotate: the final goal turns, twists, or rotates an object or control
goal_operations.pour: the final goal transfers liquid, granular material, or loose contents by tilting a source container; not putting the container itself somewhere
goal_operations.wipe: the final goal cleans or wipes a surface using a cloth, sponge, or tool
goal_operations.fold: the final goal folds or rolls a deformable item
goal_operations.unfold: the final goal unfolds, unrolls, or spreads a deformable item
goal_operations.hang: the final goal suspends or drapes an object from a hook, rack, rod, or support
goal_operations.press: the final goal presses or activates a button, key, or switch instead of moving an ordinary object
goal_operations.pull: the final goal pulls an object without opening an articulated mechanism
goal_operations.other: the final goal is not covered by any other category

operation.label: operation phrase
operation.description: a verb phrase explicitly describing a physical robot action, such as pick up, remove, place, move, push, open, close, insert, rotate, pour, wipe, fold, unfold, hang, press, or pull; extract every action in a multi-step instruction

object.label: task object
object.description: every concrete object or object part relevant to the robot task, including manipulated items, targets, containers, contents, tools, supports, surfaces, fixtures, buttons, and appliances; preserve identifying modifiers such as color, size, material, and location; exclude pronouns and directions
